nm RECONCILIATION FY2026 (10-K pf_10k_20260622 vs pf_ companyfacts vs AV nm_av_income): revenue 67,357 / 67,357 / AV 67,358 (AV +1M rounding); operating income 20,606 / 20,606 / AV 20,778 (AV +172M: provider normalization, the filing's 20,606 stands); net income 17,087 all three; CFO 31,977 10-K = pf; capex 55,663 10-K = pf; SBC 4,811 10-K cash-flow line = pf; diluted EPS 5.83 and diluted weighted shares 2,914M 10-K = pf. Net income available to common 16,984 after 103M preferred dividends.

nm RECONCILIATION Q1 FY2027 (10-Q pf_10q_20260911): revenue 19,345, operating income 6,728, net income 4,760 (to common 4,679 after 81M preferred dividends), CFO 23,103, capex 28,499, SBC 1,127, diluted EPS 1.56, diluted weighted shares 3,000M: all equal to the pf_ facts and to AV quarterly (revenue, operating income, net income). AV D&A differs by definition (AV FY2026 9,294 incl. amortization vs pf_d_and_a 7,623): use the filing lines.
nm RECONCILIATION AV CASH_FLOW was rate-limited (not retried): the second source for CFO/capex/SBC is the 10-K/10-Q text itself, read directly (lines above).

nm ONE-OFFS Q1 FY2027 CFO 23,103 includes 11,363 of customer prepayments with a significant financing component (none in Q1 FY2026); excluding them CFO is 11,740 (derived). FY2026 CFO 31,977 includes 4.6B such prepayments. These are customer-funded GPU purchases recognized as deferred revenue over the contract (10-Q note 'Customer Prepayments'): do not annualize Q1 CFO. FY2026 non-operating income 3,547 includes the gain on the Ampere stake sale (4.3B proceeds per 10-K cash-flow discussion): GAAP FY2026 net income and EPS 5.83 carry a one-time gain; Q4 FY2026 non-GAAP EPS 2.11 carries footnote 1 (one-time events: Ampere sale and Bloom Energy warrants, per the June release).

nm FUNDING Q1 FY2027: 19.9B net common stock issued through the ATM program (10-Q), diluted weighted shares 3,000M vs 2,909M a year earlier (+3.1%), 3,023,736,000 shares outstanding on 2026-09-07 (10-Q cover). FY2027 plan per the 2026-06-10 release: about 40B of debt plus equity including the 20B ATM (completed in Q1); company says no additional bonds in calendar 2026. Notes payable and other borrowings: 129,541M at 2026-05-31 (7,199 current + 122,342 non-current); non-current 117,712M at 2026-08-31 (AV current 7,625M). AV shortLongTermDebtTotal 156,189M at 2026-05-31 adds 26,648M lease obligations (capitalLeaseObligations; 30,594M at 2026-08-31): the capital bridge must decide whether lease liabilities are debt-like (gap for the analyst; 10-K lease note not read by this lane). Preferred: 5.0B liquidation preference (identity.json).

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic status 'unavailable' (needs operating income, equity, debt and cash per year). Computed here (derived, not a driver): tax rate FY2026 2,467/19,554 = 12.6% (FY2025 1,717/14,160 = 12.1%); NOPAT FY2026 20,606 x 0.874 = 18.0B, FY2025 17,678 x 0.879 = 15.5B; invested capital = equity + notes payable - cash - marketable securities: FY2026 42,508 + 129,541 - 31,289 - 605 = 140.2B, FY2025 20,451 + 92,568 - 10,786 - 417 = 101.8B; ROIC 12.8% (FY2026) vs 15.3% (FY2025); incremental ROIC (18.0-15.5)/(140.2-101.8) = 6.4%. Including lease obligations (26.6B FY2026, 11.5B FY2025) ROIC is 10.8% / 13.8%. Caveats: year-end capital, not average; construction in progress not yet earning (the capex is ahead of revenue), so incremental ROIC is depressed by timing; the low tax rate is the GAAP effective rate. FY2025 debt/lease from AV nm_av_balance (not citable until 2026-10-31 as structured data; the 10-K shows non-current 85,297 for FY2025).

nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY trailing GAAP P/E (month-end close / last reported fiscal-year diluted EPS, EPS switched each July after the 10-K; GAAP EPS is after SBC): low 15.4 (2022-06) median 37.4 high 64.8 (2025-09) now 22.2 (141.80 / TTM GAAP diluted EPS 6.38 = FY2026 5.83 - Q1 FY2026 1.01 + Q1 FY2027 1.56) years 2021-11 to 2026-10 (60 months) sources nm_ib_history, nm_ib_price, pf_eps_diluted_fy2021..fy2026, nm_eps_diluted_ttm_2026_08_31. By calendar year (low/median/high): 2022 15.4/21.8/34.5, 2023 33.7/38.1/49.4, 2024 36.4/39.6/49.8, 2025 37.7/46.2/64.8, 2026 22.3/33.7/52.0. The TTM EPS 6.38 includes the FY2026 Q2 Ampere gain (one-off), so the underlying trailing P/E is higher than 22.2. IB monthly bars are labelled with the first trading day of the month; their close is the month-end close.

nm FORWARD P/E now: 141.80 / company FY2027 non-GAAP EPS guidance 8.10 (pf_rel_20260910_1) = 17.5; / consensus FY2027 non-GAAP EPS 8.14 (nm_cons_eps_nongaap_fy2027) = 17.4. Forward P/E HISTORY is a gap: no dated historical consensus series was available (AV EARNINGS_ESTIMATES rate-limited).

nm CONSENSUS (an expectation, never a fact) S&P Global Market Intelligence via StockAnalysis.com, page updated 2026-10-27, read 2026-10-29: FY2027 (May 2027) revenue 90.4B (low 89.1B, high 91.7B, 39 analysts), non-GAAP EPS 8.14 (8.07-8.37, 39). Tight dispersion (revenue +/-1.4%), sitting just above the company's 'at least $90B' and 8.10 guidance. FY2028+ rows locked on that page (gap). Price targets (opinion, not a fact): low 110, mean 235.8, median 225, high 400 (43 analysts), consensus rating Buy. Unverified search excerpts (not used): FY2028 revenue about 130B and FY2028 EPS 8.78-10.92 on other aggregators, mutually inconsistent.

nm TRACK RECORD revenue: FY2026 67.36B vs 67B guided (ratio 1.005), Q4 FY2026 19.18B vs 19.08B midpoint (1.005), Q1 FY2027 19.35B vs 19.11B midpoint (1.013): a small, consistent beat on revenue (3 of 3). Non-GAAP EPS beat (Q4 FY2026 2.11 vs 1.98 incl. one-time items; Q1 FY2027 1.92 vs 1.74). Cloud growth near the midpoint (Q4 47% vs 46-50%; Q1 62% vs 58-64%). OCI FY2026 18.1B vs 18B forecast in Sept 2025 (met). Misses: FY2026 total cloud growth 38.7% vs 'over 40%' (June 2025 release); FY2026 capex 55.7B vs 50B guided (11% over: spending runs above plan). Quarterly guidance was given only on the calls before Q3 FY2026, so earlier periods are not in the releases (gap). Revenue guidance is conservative-but-tight; capex guidance under-states spend.

nm RISK-FREE: market.risk_free is owned by the prefetch (pf_fred_dgs10: DGS10 4.99% on 2026-10-27, macro/fred/DGS10.csv); this lane confirmed the value and does not write a market block (ticker-check: market belongs to the prefetch and gather_macro).

nm GEOGRAPHY FY2026 (10-K Note 13): revenue U.S. 39,835 (59.1%), UK 2,816, Germany 1,993, Japan 1,870, other 20,843; Americas 44,478 (66.0%), EMEA 15,297 (22.7%), APAC 7,582 (11.3%). Long-lived assets (excl. goodwill/intangibles) 133,264 total, U.S. 102,717 (77.1%), UK 3,903, Germany 2,432, Japan 3,183, other 21,029; total long-lived assets more than doubled from 60,143 (FY2025). Q1 FY2027: Americas contributed 90% of constant-currency revenue growth (10-Q).

nm EXPOSURES (10-K risk factors, read in reading/10k_full.txt): export controls/sanctions: 'evolving restrictions and rules governing access to cloud-based infrastructure or GPU-enabled services by customers in certain jurisdictions' could limit the ability to provide GPU capacity (share exposed not quantified by the company: gap); tariffs and trade wars named in the safe-harbor list and as a hardware cost/demand factor (hardware revenue 3.1B, about 4.6% of FY2026 revenue); GPU sourcing ('sourcing of technologies and technology components such as graphic processing units') is a named risk; Taiwan supply share not disclosed (gap). Customer concentration: no customer at 10% of FY2026 revenue (10-K), but RPO growth came from large AI contracts (OpenAI, Meta, NVIDIA named in releases) and the 10-K warns that key customers' inability to pay could force long-lived asset impairment reviews.
